linkedin.text:
🚨 You're writing custom agent instructions for Cloud Run. Then GKE. Then BigQuery. Then Gemini API. Then realizing you've spent three weeks on prompt engineering that Google already solved.

The usual approach hurts because every new Google service needs new context, new examples, and new guardrails. Your agent forgets half of it by the next deploy.

✅ Google Skills gives you 100+ pre-built agent capabilities
✅ Covers everything from GKE troubleshooting to Well-Architected Framework reviews
✅ One npx command installs exactly the skills you need

16,000+ developers are already using it. The repo includes AI/ML workflows, infrastructure configs, database skills, and full solution architectures.

Search "Google Skills" on GitHub and pick the capabilities your agent actually needs.

Which Google service do you wish your agent understood better? 💡
